decision.summary: NO_ACTION: keep the existing 76k DIP position open; it is still aligned with Beecthor and not yet near any take-profit or reduction threshold.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. The context is readable, reconciliation is ok, daily_success_cooldown is inactive, and there is already one active daily thesis position: `will-bitcoin-dip-to-76k-on-may-19` Yes, opened around 0.4799 and now marked around 0.52 for a modest unrealized gain. Beecthor's latest D-1 thesis remains bearish and still favors continuation down rather than chasing upside. Live Binance also remains broadly consistent with that view: spot is 76718.85, below the UTC day open, with negative 24h/48h performance and price still much closer to the downside than to the upside targets. On Polymarket, the same market is still active and non-discarded at roughly 0.525, which confirms the bearish setup but is far below the 80-85% partial take-profit zone and the 90-95% close zone. There is no basis for a stop-loss-style exit, and re-adding is not justified because the same-market cash already sits at the early-stage single-position cap. With the thesis still valid and no management trigger hit, the correct action is to hold.
